murim.configuration.accessibility.title: Accessibility
murim.configuration.cameraShakePercent.t: Strength of camera shake on impact. Set to 0 to disable camera shake completely.
murim.configuration.hitStopPercent.toolt: Strength of the brief freeze on impact. Set to 0 to disable it completely.
murim.configuration.screenFlashes.toolti: Edge darkening shown at the moment of impact.
murim.configuration.distortionEffects.to: Directional streaks shown at the moment of impact. Techniques stay readable without them.
murim.configuration.vfx.title: Effect Quality
murim.configuration.quality.tooltip: Detail level of blade trails and particle density.
